# Silent Penguin Tax Services

> Silent Penguin Tax Services (legal name: Silent Penguin PLLC) is a fully remote U.S. CPA firm based in Mercer Island, Washington, serving the Greater Seattle area and clients nationwide. It specializes in U.S. expat / international tax, cryptocurrency reporting, offshore (Streamlined) compliance, and trust & estate returns. Service is 100% online and asynchronous — secure portal and email, no phone calls — with flat-fee pricing and CPA-prepared, e-filed returns.

Key facts:
- Licensed CPA firm. Founder: Lucanus "Luke" Lam, CPA. IRS e-file provider. Secure client portal (AES-256).
- Fully remote and asynchronous: email + secure portal, no phone calls. Flat-fee pricing. Serves all 50 states.
- Specialties: U.S. expat / foreign income tax, cryptocurrency & digital-asset tax, Streamlined offshore disclosure (SDOP / SFOP), trust & estate income tax (Form 1041), S-Corp and small business returns (Form 1120-S, Form 1065, state income and franchise tax returns), amended returns (Form 1040-X), and IRS / state notice response.
- Does NOT offer: payroll processing or payroll tax filings, ongoing monthly bookkeeping, sales/use tax or B&O filings, or retainer services. Simple records for small businesses may be accepted case by case.
- Languages: English and Cantonese (廣東話).
- Location: Mercer Island, WA (remote). Contact: hello@silentpenguintax.com

## Services
- [U.S. Expat & International Tax](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/expat-tax): Remote expat tax preparation — Foreign Earned Income Exclusion (Form 2555), Foreign Tax Credit (Form 1116), FBAR (FinCEN Form 114), FATCA (Form 8938), PFICs (Form 8621), foreign pensions, and streamlined catch-up filing.
- [Cryptocurrency Tax Reporting](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/crypto-tax): Capital gains and losses (Form 8949 / Schedule D), staking and mining income, DeFi, NFTs, FIFO vs. specific-identification cost basis, and multi-wallet / multi-exchange reconciliation.
- [Streamlined Offshore Disclosure (SDOP / SFOP)](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/streamlined-offshore): Non-willful catch-up under the IRS Streamlined Filing Compliance Procedures — three years of amended returns, six years of FBARs, and the Form 14654 / 14653 certification narrative.
- [Trust & Estate Income Tax (Form 1041)](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/trust-tax): Fiduciary income tax returns, beneficiary Schedule K-1s, distributable net income, grantor vs. non-grantor trusts, and the decedent's final Form 1040.
- [S-Corp & Small Business Tax](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/s-corp-tax): Form 1120-S and shareholder K-1s, state income and franchise tax returns, reasonable compensation review, shareholder basis (Form 7203), S-election analysis, Form 2553 and late-election relief; partnerships (Form 1065). Payroll and monthly bookkeeping not included.

## About the founder
- [Meet Your CPA: Luke Lam](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/about/): Licensed CPA in Washington State, founder of Silent Penguin PLLC, 10+ years of tax preparation and consulting experience; fully remote, secure cloud-based, flat-fee. Bilingual English/Cantonese.

## 中文服務 (Chinese-language pages)
- [中文主頁 — 香港及華人移民美國稅務](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh/): 粵語/英語雙語 CPA 服務:全球收入申報、FBAR/FATCA 海外戶口、強積金、加密貨幣、SDOP 自願披露。
- [October 15 Deadline: What's Actually Due](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/guides/october-15-deadline-what-is-due/): Final deadline for extended 2025 individual returns, what is and isn't due that day, penalties, and what to do if you miss it.
- [Extension to File, Not to Pay](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/guides/extension-more-time-to-file-not-to-pay/): Why Form 4868 did not extend the payment date; failure-to-file vs failure-to-pay penalties and relief options.
- [October 15 Checklist for Americans Abroad](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/guides/october-15-checklist-abroad/): Expat document checklist, FEIE vs FTC, FBAR/8938/8621, and the discretionary December 15 extension.
- [Haven't Filed Taxes in Years? Your Options](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/guides/havent-filed-taxes-in-years/): The six-year look-back, penalties only on unpaid tax, three-year refund window, substitute returns, and the streamlined route for foreign accounts.
- [中文 deadline 及補報指南(繁 / 简)](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh/guides/october-15-deadline-what-is-due/): 10 月 15 日期限、延期不等於延繳、海外人士 checklist、多年未報稅 — 均有繁體及簡體版本(/zh/guides/ 與 /zh-cn/guides/)。
- [FBAR 中文指南](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh/guides/who-must-file-fbar/): 誰需要申報 FBAR;香港銀行戶口、聯名戶口、強積金與儲蓄保險的申報規則。
- [SDOP 中文指南](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh/guides/streamlined-domestic-offshore-sdop/): 漏報海外收入及戶口的簡化補救程序 — 資格、5% 罰款與 Form 14654。

- [简体中文主页 — 华人移民美国税务](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh-cn/): 中英双语 CPA 服务:海外账户申报、国内理财与公积金、加密货币、自愿披露。
- [FBAR 简体中文指南](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh-cn/guides/who-must-file-fbar/): 谁需要申报 FBAR;国内银行账户、联名账户、理财与住房公积金的申报规则。
- [SDOP 简体中文指南](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh-cn/guides/streamlined-domestic-offshore-sdop/): 漏报海外收入及账户的简化补救程序 — 资格、5% 罚款与 Form 14654。

- [中文服務頁(繁體)](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh/expat-tax/) — 移民及跨境稅務;另有 [加密貨幣](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh/crypto-tax/)、[海外自願披露](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh/streamlined-offshore/)、[信託及遺產](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh/trust-tax/)、[S 公司](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh/s-corp-tax/)。
- [中文服务页(简体)](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh-cn/expat-tax/) — 移民及跨境税务;另有 [加密货币](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh-cn/crypto-tax/)、[海外自愿披露](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh-cn/streamlined-offshore/)、[信托及遗产](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh-cn/trust-tax/)、[S 公司](https://www.silentpenguintax.com/zh-cn/s-corp-tax/)。
